subject.title: Dashboard: inter-widget pub/sub — a tab-scoped, parent-brokered message bus

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this sandboxed custom-widget pub/sub bridge as part of the bundled modular dashboard stack?
rationale: The PR changes the untrusted widget message boundary and is stacked on an unmerged dashboard bridge while also triggering the dependency-graph guard, so automation cannot decide the product/security direction.

options.title: Review After Stack Hygiene
options.body: Ask for the branch to be retargeted or unstacked against an accepted custom-widget base and for dependency graph changes to be removed before reviewing the bus delta.

options.title: Security-Sponsor Current Head
options.body: A maintainer or security owner can explicitly approve the current dependency graph and review the cumulative sandbox bridge as one large feature branch.

options.title: Defer Pub/Sub Direction
options.body: Keep the linked issue open but pause this PR until the modular dashboard bridge has product and security sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Review After Stack Hygiene
recommendation.body: Ask for the branch to be retargeted or unstacked against an accepted custom-widget base and for dependency graph changes to be removed before reviewing the bus delta.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current-main Control UI plugin-tab seam this dashboard surface extends and is the best available product/security routing candidate from history.
